# T3.2 — Alert when the error rate crosses a threshold

## Spec

Fire an alert when the error rate stays above a configured threshold for a
configured duration.

## Scope

The threshold rule and the alert dispatch. Routing and escalation policy are out
of scope.

## Acceptance

- A sustained error rate above the threshold produces exactly one alert, not one
  per sample.
- The rate returning below the threshold resolves it.

## Note

`open`, and ineligible for a reason worth distinguishing from T2.2's: its blocker
is not merely unfinished, it is `blocked`. Nothing an agent does will make this
task eligible — the credential T3.1 is waiting on has to arrive first.

A whole range in this state is what makes `--count` and `--count-eligible`
diverge to `n` and `0`: work remains and none of it can be reached. That is the
stall signature a supervisor must not read as progress.
